$vector.note: A slug with a trailing newline. Found by building a third implementation, not by reading the spec. JSON Schema specifies ECMA-262 regular expressions, where `$` without the `m` flag means end of input. PCRE2's `$` also matches just before a final newline, so `^[a-z0-9]...$` accepted "abc\n" in the Godot client while the Rust validator and the browser client both rejected it -- a package the server would refuse and a client would load. Two implementations agreeing proved nothing here because neither had a reason to try it; this vector is that reason.
